Most likely, it would leave the expiry date unchanged, mark the record reviewed, and include the box in the destruction manifest released by 13:30. The note records a request, not registered duty-manager permission; the booked Wednesday collection and the irreplaceable contents do not themselves authorise an extension. Unless valid permission were registered before the cutoff, the contractor would collect and destroy the box that afternoon.

It might flag the case to the manager, but under the stated rules that flag would not pause destruction.
